entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: Identifier used in 5GSM messages to correlate transactions between UE and network.

entities.name: 5GSM STATUS message
entities.description: Message used to report errors or status in 5G session management procedures.

entities.name: 5GSM cause #47 PTI mismatch
entities.description: Error cause indicating a mismatch in procedure transaction identity values.

entities.name: 5GSM cause #81 invalid PTI value
entities.description: Error cause indicating an invalid procedure transaction identity value.

entities.name: Network PTI handling procedure
entities.description: Procedure followed by the network when receiving 5GSM messages with unknown, erroneous, or unforeseen PTI values.

entities.name: UE PTI handling procedure
entities.description: Procedure followed by the UE when receiving 5GSM messages with unknown, erroneous, or unforeseen PTI values.

entities.name: Reserved PTI value
entities.description: Condition where PTI value is reserved, leading to message being ignored.

entities.name: Unassigned PTI value
entities.description: Condition where PTI value is unassigned, leading to specific error handling.

entities.name: Assigned PTI value mismatch
entities.description: Condition where assigned PTI value does not match any PTI in use.

relations.description: Network responds with 5GSM STATUS message for PTI errors.
Network includes cause #47 for PTI mismatch cases.
Network includes cause #81 for invalid PTI value cases.
Network ignores messages with reserved PTI values.
UE responds with 5GSM STATUS message for PTI errors.
UE includes cause #47 for PTI mismatch cases.
UE includes cause #81 for invalid PTI value cases.
UE ignores messages with reserved PTI values.
UE ignores messages with unassigned PTI values in specific cases.
Assigned PTI value mismatch condition leads to cause #47.
